assertions.description: An over-sized declared file is refused with SANDBOX_LIMIT_EXCEEDED naming the per-file byte cap.
The request cap answers 429 with zero bytes returned, rather than hanging.
A probe whose data source never resolves fails with PROBE_TIMEOUT well inside the declared bound.
The expression language refuses oversized, over-nested and loop-shaped programs: there is no way to write a non-terminating program.
The CSP denies defaults, connections, objects, base URIs, form actions and framing.
A tight wall-clock budget still returns a governed response with the CSP header, never an ungoverned one.
